0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300010_ALISAIE
0.description: Gods, he is almost whole again!

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300020_ALPHINAUD
1.description: His size is staggering... I can scarce imagine how Grandfather stood against such a monstrosity.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300030_ALISAIE
2.description: This cannot be allowed to proceed any further. Let us disable the coil and move on.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300060_ALISAIE
4.description: No, that man is dead. I will not dishonor my beloved grandsire's memory by calling you such.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300070_ALISAIE
5.description: You are but his twisted shade─the thrall of a mad primal.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300080_LOUISOIX
6.description: You were foolish to disregard my warning, child. Are you so convinced of your own righteousness?

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300090_ALPHINAUD
7.description: 'Tis the rightness of our path that led us to return. Eorzea will never be safe whilst Bahamut remains to threaten all we hold dear.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300100_ALPHINAUD
8.description: What of the hero who gave his life in defense of the realm? Do you truly dispute the justice of our cause?

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300110_LOUISOIX
9.description: My poor, ignorant grandchildren─your world is shaped by naught but recent conflict. Listen, and I will speak to you of “justice.”

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300120_LOUISOIX
10.description: 'Twas in the twilight of the Third Astral Era... The southern land of Meracydia suffered invasion at the hands of the Allagan Empire. With no atrocity too depraved for their purpose, the forces of Allag were unstoppable in their advance.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300130_LOUISOIX
11.description: Desperate for salvation, the dragons prayed to one of the first brood─to their ancestor Bahamut. Infused by the power of their fervent supplications, Bahamut arose from the abyss of death and took wing as the Meracydians' newborn god.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300140_LOUISOIX
12.description: Yet this great miracle would only serve to further the maniacal designs of the dragons' imperial conquerors. The cruel fetters which bind my lord stand testament to the Allagans' boundless greed and hubris.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300150_LOUISOIX
13.description: I once summoned the Twelve in an attempt to forestall the advent of the Seventh Umbral Era.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300160_LOUISOIX
14.description: What then did the dragons of Meracydia do that I did not? Wherefore are they accursed and I exalted?

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300170_LOUISOIX
15.description: 'Tis man's overweening belief in his own primacy that blinds him to the commonness of his condition...and the truth of his own tyranny.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300180_LOUISOIX
16.description: As long as man is suffered to remain, the dragons shall never be at peace.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300190_LOUISOIX
17.description: Only when the plague of people has been expunged shall the children of Lord Bahamut be free. Then shall the world know true justice.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300200_ALISAIE
18.description: Stop it! Grandfather would never say such things! His belief that people were worth saving never faltered!

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300210_ALISAIE
19.description: He had faith in their strength...that they could stand together and push back against the darkness seeking to shape them.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300220_LOUISOIX
20.description: A false hope. 'Tis folly to place one's faith in so flawed a race.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300230_LOUISOIX
21.description: "Stand together“? Hmph. They would first need to agree on which direction to face. If history teaches us anything, it is that man cannot find common ground between his own two feet.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300240_LOUISOIX
22.description: Even you, twins whose veins run with the same blood, struggle to fathom each other's reasoning. You hide your differing agendas behind the convenient banner of Eorzea's salvation. Given your obvious self-interest, can you truly claim no kinship with the Allagans?

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300250_LOUISOIX
23.description: And though I hoped they might bring you closer, 'twould seem that the twin grimoires I bestowed upon you were a wasted gesture...

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300260_ALPHINAUD
24.description: There may well be truth in your judgment of Alisaie and me... But such a one-sided tirade bemoaning the evils of man rings false coming from the lips of Archon Louisoix.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300270_ALPHINAUD
25.description: Tell me─do you champion the cause of dragons because Bahamut compels you as his thrall?

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300280_ALPHINAUD
26.description: Or is it because you yourself have transcended the limits of man's existence?

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300290_LOUISOIX
27.description: Ah, so the possibility did not escape your notice? What I prayed for, and what I have become...these are the <hex:021A020203>keys<hex:021A020103> that unlock the truth behind Eorzea's rebirth.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300300_LOUISOIX
28.description: If you would have them, then you must needs take them by force. Come, rend this divine form asunder and claim your answers!

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300310_ALISAIE
29.description: But...I thought... He has become a primal!?

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300320_ALPHINAUD
30.description: 'Tis difficult I know, but you must accept it: that entity is no phantom or impostor─it is our beloved grandsire!

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_300330_ALISAIE
31.description: Please─for his sake and for ours─you must defeat our grandfather!

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400010_ALISAIE
32.description: Grandfather is truly gone this time. But better it end this way than the alternative...

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400020_LOUISOIX
33.description: I am yet here, Alisaie. My dear, sweet granddaughter...

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400040_LOUISOIX
35.description: I must thank you, Warrior of Light. Without your valor, I might never have broken free of Bahamut's control.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400050_LOUISOIX
36.description: These last few moments are mine to live as the man I once was.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400060_ALISAIE
37.description: This is all that I wanted. Yet now that it is happening, I find myself struggling to believe it... Is it really you?

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400070_ALPHINAUD
38.description: Grandfather, pray forgive me my insolence. It was not my intent to demean you.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400080_LOUISOIX
39.description: Forgive you? I am proud of you, child. You were wise enough to deduce the manner of creature I had become.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400090_LOUISOIX
40.description: Alphinaud. Alisaie. If any here should beg forgiveness, it is I.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400100_ALISAIE
41.description: Grandfather, I must ask... Will you not tell us what befell during the Calamity?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400110_LOUISOIX
42.description: Yes. Yes, of course. You have come far to hear the truth...

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400120_LOUISOIX
43.description: Let us then begin the tale at the Battle of Carteneau, where clashed the forces of the Garlean Empire and the Eorzean Alliance.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400130_LOUISOIX
44.description: 'Twas there in the sky above the surging armies that the elder primal Bahamut broke free of the red moon, Dalamud.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400140_LOUISOIX
45.description: In an effort to contain this avatar of destruction, I called upon the Twelve to aid me in the creation of a prison of aether...

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400150_LOUISOIX
46.description: But Bahamut would not be caged by such feeble bars─too vast was his might; too fierce his rage.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400170_LOUISOIX
48.description: You know of what happened next. I used the last of my strength to send you and your companions outside of time, and then prepared to meet my end.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_400180_LOUISOIX
49.description: Little choice remained to me. I used the last of my strength to entrust our hope unto the future, and prepared to meet my end.

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500010_LOUISOIX
50.description: As you have no doubt surmised, I did not perish. When the cage built from the essences of the Twelve was destroyed, the sky was filled with a colossal cloud of aether...

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500020_LOUISOIX
51.description: This drifting energy responded to the prayers of those fighting below─and to my own desperate wish that the dying realm be saved─by infusing me with the power of a primal.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500030_LOUISOIX
52.description: I became the immortal Phoenix, ancient symbol of rebirth.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500040_LOUISOIX
53.description: Rising into the sky, I struck Bahamut with all my newfound strength. The blow shattered his earthly form, and a shower of aether rained down upon the land.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500050_LOUISOIX
54.description: Thus began the rejuvenation of Eorzea.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500060_LOUISOIX
55.description: Believing the deed done, I relinquished my hold on that staggering energy, desirous that it should be returned to the realm without delay.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500070_LOUISOIX
56.description: But I had not reckoned on Bahamut's tenacious will. Even as he teetered upon the cusp of oblivion, the dragon reached out to claim me.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500080_LOUISOIX
57.description: Alas, within my fast fading form, enough remained of the Phoenix's energy to offer Bahamut a hold, and he dragged me along in his wake.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500090_ALPHINAUD
58.description: And thus began your existence as the elder primal's thrall...

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500100_ALISAIE
59.description: I cannot help but wonder at his will to survive... Though he was all but obliterated, Bahamut found a way to seize the power you surrendered.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500110_ALISAIE
60.description: That would explain why part of his physical form survived to be entombed underground.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500120_ALPHINAUD
61.description: 'Twould also explain why Eorzea was so terribly warped. Even as the land sought to restore itself, the returning flow of aether was cut off.

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500130_LOUISOIX
62.description: Very good. When his grip on existence was once again secured, Bahamut did not cease his feast until he had consumed every last mote of aether that yet floated in the air.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500140_ALISAIE
63.description: And <hex:021A020203>still<hex:021A020103> he was not fully restored...

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500150_LOUISOIX
64.description: You must remember that by this time, much of the freed aether had already returned to the land. That which remained was not sufficient to reconstruct so massive a form in its entirety.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500160_LOUISOIX
65.description: But there did not need to be─not for a being sustained by the marvels of Allagan technology.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500170_LOUISOIX
66.description: As long as some piece of Bahamut persists, the coils will seek it out and continue their regenerative task.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500180_LOUISOIX
67.description: The fragments of Dalamud appear motionless from the surface, but deep beneath the ground they had been searching...tunneling through rock and soil towards their escaped prisoner.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500190_LOUISOIX
68.description: And, as you have observed for yourselves, they found his heart.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500200_LOUISOIX
69.description: Warrior of Light, heed me. You must put a stop to Bahamut's regeneration.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500210_LOUISOIX
70.description: Whether it be for man or for dragonkind, the question of justice is irrelevant. The elder primal will leave naught but a smoldering wasteland for both his children and ours.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500220_LOUISOIX
71.description: I beg you to defend Eorzea─as you always have, and as I always knew you would.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500230_LOUISOIX
72.description: I beg you to defend Eorzea, and guide its people to the future they yet struggle to find.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500240_LOUISOIX
73.description: This portal will take you to the final internment hulk. 'Tis time for the tale of Bahamut and his part in the Calamity to come to an end!

75.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500260_LOUISOIX
75.description: Your hopes and dreams must no longer be an extension of mine. You must needs find your own reason to fight for this realm─your own meaning in this sea of chaos.

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500270_LOUISOIX
76.description: Will you do that for me?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500280_ALPHINAUD
77.description: Of course, Grandfather. I have already made it my mission to see this newborn Eorzea survive and flourish.

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500290_LOUISOIX
78.description: Alisaie. While I was yet in thrall to Bahamut, you spoke of my faith in man's strength. Know that your words reached me, imprisoned though my soul still was.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500300_LOUISOIX
79.description: So forceful was your conviction, I wonder if that belief has not become your own. Perhaps, after all your anger and sorrow was spent, you found something greater within you.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500310_LOUISOIX
80.description: See this fight to its culmination. 'Tis also <hex:021A020203>your<hex:021A020103> strength in which I have faith.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500320_ALISAIE
81.description: Thank you...for everything... Pray take your rest, Grandfather... You deserve it.

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500330_LOUISOIX
82.description: There are records of an art that allowed one to summon the power of a primal from the essence of its demise.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500340_LOUISOIX
83.description: And though I am no true primal, all that I have left, I give to you.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500350_LOUISOIX
84.description: Alphinaud. Alisaie. My darling grandchildren. May Light's blessings ever keep and protect you.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_500360_ALISAIE
85.description: Come, Warrior of Light. Our task remains undone!

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600010_ALISAIE
86.description: 'Twas a long and arduous road, but at last we reach its end.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600020_ALISAIE
87.description: Farewell, Bahamut. I banish you back to the aether!

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600030_ALISAIE
88.description: He is not yet whole! I did not think him capable...

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600070_ALISAIE
92.description: I had thought it finally over...

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600090_ALISAIE
94.description: No... Is this how I honor my promise to Grandfather?

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600100_LOUISOIX
95.description: You must needs find your own reason to fight for this realm─your own meaning in this sea of chaos. Will you do that for me?

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600110_ALISAIE
96.description: I will, Grandfather. In fact, I believe I already have.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600120_ALISAIE
97.description: That reason has been with me all along, guiding me─Eorzea's blade of Light, shearing through the endless shrouds of darkness...

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600130_ALISAIE
98.description: I have been shown the miraculous feats of which we are all capable. Of which <hex:021A020203>I<hex:021A020103> am capable.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600140_ALISAIE
99.description: Bahamut! You have wreaked enough havoc!

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600150_ALISAIE
100.description: I will not let your wrathful fires consume all that we know and love!

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600170_ALPHINAUD
102.description: How long I have waited to hear you say that! You have found your resolve at last!

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600180_ALPHINAUD
103.description: Let me join my strength to yours.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600190_ALPHINAUD
104.description: In this place, in this moment, our purpose has become one!

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600191_ALPHINAUDANDALISAIE
105.description: (-Alphinaud and Alisaie-)For the future of Eorzea!

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_600200_ALISAIE
106.description: This last task is yours, Warrior of Light! You must destroy Bahamut's crystal core!

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700030_ALISAIE
109.description: With this last coil disabled, there shall be naught left to bind Bahamut to this world. His beloved children will finally know peace...

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700050_ALISAIE
111.description: You knew, didn't you? You knew what Grandfather had become.

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700060_ALPHINAUD
112.description: I...was not certain. But from all I had gleaned, it seemed a distinct possibility.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700070_ALPHINAUD
113.description: The scene people describe of the Battle of Carteneau was one of unimaginable devastation. And 'tis through the combined prayers of the desperate─and an abundant source of aether─that primals are born. I merely put two and two together.

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700080_ALISAIE
114.description: And you consider that a sufficient explanation?

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700090_ALISAIE
115.description: Well, however you stumbled across your theory, 'twas this revelation that made you wary of my attachment to Grandfather.

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700100_ALISAIE
116.description: You feared that in my obsession, I would fall under his primal sway. Is that why you decided to join us? To pull me back should I show signs of wavering?

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700110_ALPHINAUD
117.description: Pray forgive me, Sister. I wished only to protect you. Yet I see now that I needn't have doubted the strength of your conviction.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700120_ALPHINAUD
118.description: May I ask you a question? What do you now intend to do with the truth you have uncovered?

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700130_ALISAIE
119.description: Which particular truth was that, Brother? The fact that desperate prayer gave rise to the primal Phoenix? That this new god was responsible for setting Eorzea on the path to rebirth?

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700140_ALISAIE
120.description: Should such a tale become common knowledge, people would soon offer up their prayers in earnest─they would beseech Phoenix to complete the healing that was begun.

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700150_ALPHINAUD
121.description: Yet as you and I know all too well, the very act of calling forth this savior would do more harm to the land than good.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700160_ALPHINAUD
122.description: We cannot encourage such worship for this very reason. Were Grandfather forced to return as an aether-draining primal, 'twould undo all that he had worked to protect.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700170_ALPHINAUD
123.description: Your abiding love for him was the key that unlocked the truth of the Calamity.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700180_ALPHINAUD
124.description: But keys may also serve to seal doors that were best left unopened.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700190_ALPHINAUD
125.description: Let your love now guide your actions, and lock away deep inside the fate of both Grandfather and Bahamut.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700200_ALISAIE
126.description: Fear not, Alphinaud─I understand what must be done.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700210_ALISAIE
127.description: The realm need not know the truth for it to be saved.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700220_ALISAIE
128.description: That the elder primal is banished, to return no more...that is enough.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_02401_700230_ALISAIE
129.description: Let us make our way back to the surface. Poor Urianger must be beside himself with worry!
